people_rule._note: 規則甲 —— people 由 publicness 推導，不再逐格手掛

people_text.solo: She is the only person in the photograph; no other people are visible anywhere in the frame.
people_text.background_crowd: Far behind her and much smaller in the frame than she is, one or two {crowd} are already walking out of the frame, so far back that they read only as soft blurred silhouettes with no facial features. Nobody stands level with her or beside either shoulder; the ground and air immediately around her are empty, and she is the only sharply focused thing in the picture.
people_text.background_seated: Well behind her and much smaller in the frame, one or two {crowd} stay seated and turned away, held far enough back and far enough out of focus that they read as soft shapes with no facial features. Nobody is standing, walking past, or level with her shoulders, and she is the only sharply focused thing in the picture.

wall_rule: 規則丙 —— 沿用 rulefix_v1 已驗證的正面描述（2/2 通過）：Every wall, panel and screen behind her carries only plain surfaces and printed text — notices, price cards and signage lettering — and no framed pictures, posters or displays of any kind hang on them.
